integrity: Analytic proof independently reconstructed; finite exact coefficient and rational Routh checks provided as corroboration, not substituted for proof. No independent external audit or certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The proof establishes only open-left-half-plane independence-root location for double stars (equivalently trees of diameter at most three). It does not establish analogous stability for longer-diameter trees or a uniform quantitative root margin. Several boundary cases were established earlier; originality concerns the full two-branching-center family.
title: Strict left-half-plane independence-root stability of double-star trees
